body:
PR Summary by Qodo

Void post-send connection failures instead of retrying 🐞 Bug fix 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 10-20 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Prevent duplicate provider billing by never retrying a connection lost after the full request was
>  sent.
>• Record those failures as voids while preserving pre-send and retryable-response retries.
>• Align the specification, schema descriptions, and gateway tests with the retry boundary.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD GW["Gateway"] --> SEND{"Request fully sent?"} -->|yes| WAIT["Await response"] --> FAIL{"Failure type?"} -->|connection lost| VOID["Void attempt"] SEND -->|pre-send failure| RETRY["Retry with backoff"] --> GW FAIL -->|timeout| UNKNOWN["Usage unknown"] WAIT -->|408, 429, 5xx| RETRY ```
High-Level Assessment

>Keep the send-completion boundary in the gateway: it avoids assuming the provider supports idempotency and preserves retries where a complete request was not sent or the provider explicitly returned a retryable status.
Files changed (4) +63 / -20

Bug fix (1) +13 / -9
gateway.pyVoid connections lost after the full request was sent +13/-9
>Void connections lost after the full request was sent > >
>• In _open_upstream, a post-send connection or HTTP exception now returns failed without entering retry backoff; post-send timeouts still return timeout. Module and method documentation describe the boundary.
>
> >hb/gateway.py
Tests (1) +38 / -2
test_gateway.pyCover post-send voids and pre-send retries +38/-2
>Cover post-send voids and pre-send retries > >
>• Adds tests for a dropped connection after the provider receives the full request, including no retry and local responses to later requests, and for retries on refused connections before sending. Existing retry and shutdown-backoff tests use retryable HTTP statuses instead of a post-send drop.
>
> >tests/test_gateway.py
Documentation (2) +12 / -9
result-bundle.mdSpecify the post-send no-retry and void rules +10/-7
>Specify the post-send no-retry and void rules > >
>• Limits connection and TLS retries to failures before the full request was sent. Adds post-send connection loss before a response to the void causes and distinguishes it from usage_unknown timeouts.
>
> >docs/spec/result-bundle.md
gateway-record.schema.jsonClarify outcomes and retry counts in record descriptions +2/-2
>Clarify outcomes and retry counts in record descriptions > >
>• Documents post-send connection loss as an upstream_failed void and clarifies which failures can contribute to upstream_attempts. The schema’s validation constraints are unchanged.
>
> >schemas/gateway-record.schema.json

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
